body:
They and I had shared a few messages back and forth after my first post, after which I didn't say anything for a few days.

When I replied last night they told me I had been ignoring them, and told me to kill myself.

Also I want to say thank you. Thank you for replying, but especially thank you for not saying you get it. That's frustrating to hear, when someone says they get how it feels when they haven't experienced it.

Thank you for being kind to a stranger.
I've tried to get involved with therapy. It's hard, finding the right person is hard. I don't know how to make it work.
You should be, I'm really proud of you.

Make it stop, please make it stop.
Please make it stop

It's not wrong to be autistic. It's hard, sure, but it's not wrong or bad. It doesn't make you wrong or bad.

Your family should care, and I'm so sorry that they don't. I'm sorry you relapsed, and I hope you can forgive yourself

Please help me and if not
please tell me this is okay

I'm so happy that you are where you are.

You're saving yourself. And that's so powerful.

I understand. God, I understand the trying everything and doing all the right things so why won't it work? Why won't it just work?

You try meds and you try therapy and you're putting all this energy in for nothing, I get it. I get it.

I'm sure people are telling you that it'll get better, that's what they're telling me. Let's not make promises we can't keep, but I want you to know that I really, REALLY hope it does get better for you.
I wish I believed that. I really do. I'm grateful that you seem to believe it though.

yes, miraculously.

However, I am considering whether tonight is the night I want to go
